H0397.name: Achish
H0397.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H0397.brief: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David
H0397.short: Achish, also referred to as Abimelech, was the Philistine king of Gath who granted refuge to David when he fled from King Saul, but later dismissed him due to the suspicion of his servants.
H0397.meaning: “I will blacken (or terrify)” or “only a man”

forms.meaning: “I will blacken (or terrify)” or “only a man”
“Melek is father” or “my father is king”

H0316.name: Aharhel
H0316.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0316.brief: Son of Harum, from the tribe of Judah
H0316.short: Aharhel was a son of Harum, a descendant of Judah.

H0308.name: Ahasbai
H0308.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0308.brief: Father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men
H0308.short: Ahasbai the Maachathite was the father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men.

H0325.name: Ahasuerus
H0325.desc: Emperor Xerxes I, living at the time of Exile and Return
H0325.brief: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther
H0325.short: Ahasuerus, Emperor of Persia (probably Xerxes I), chose Esther as his queen and issued decrees impacting the Jews.

H0313.name: Aher
H0313.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0313.brief: Son of Shemer, from the tribe of Asher
H0313.short: Aher was a son of Shemer, a descendant of Asher.

H0300.name: Ahishahar
H0300.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0300.short: Ahishahar was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.
H0300.meaning: “my brother is dawn” or “brother of the dawn”

forms.meaning: “my brother is dawn” or “brother of the dawn”

H0301.name: Ahishar
H0301.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0301.short: Ahishar was in charge of King Solomon's palace.

H0302.name: Ahithophel
H0302.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H0302.brief: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide
H0302.short: Ahithophel was a wise counselor to David who defected to Absalom's side during Absalom's rebellion, but later committed suicide when his advice was not followed.

H0304H.name: Ahlai
H0304H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0304H.brief: Father of Zabad, one of David's mighty men
H0304H.short: Ahlai was the father of Zabad, who was one of David's mighty men.

H0304G.name: Ahlai
H0304G.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0304G.short: Ahlai was the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

H0345H.name: Aiah
H0345H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0345H.short: Aiah was the father of Rizpah, who was a concubine of King Saul.

H0345G.name: Aiah
H0345G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0345G.brief: Son of Zibeon the Hivite, brother of Anah
H0345G.short: Aiah was the son of Zibeon the Hivite and the brother of Anah, who was a descendant of Esau.

H0333G.name: Ater
H0333G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0333G.brief: Head of a family that returned from Babylonian exile
H0333G.short: Ater was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (<ref="Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21">Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21</ref>).

H0333H.name: Ater
H0333H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0333H.brief: Head of a family of gatekeepers who returned from exile
H0333H.short: Ater was the head of a family of gatekeepers who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (<ref="Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45">Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45</ref>).

H0333I.name: Ater
H0333I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0333I.brief: One of the signers of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H0333I.short: Ater was one of the individuals who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah's reforms (<ref="Neh.10.17">Neh.10.17</ref>).

H0356G.name: Elon
H0356G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0356G.short: Elon the Hittite was the father of Basemath, one of Esau's wives.

H0356H.name: Elon
H0356H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0356H.brief: A son of Zebulun and founder of the Elonites.
H0356H.short: Elon was a son of Zebulun and the founder of the Elonite clan within the tribe of Zebulun.

H0356J.name: Elon
H0356J.brief: A judge of Israel from the tribe of Zebulun.
H0356J.short: Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel for ten years.

H0368.name: Emim
H0368.brief: An ancient people group defeated by Chedorlaomer.
H0368.short: The Emim were a tall and numerous people who inhabited the region of Moab before the Moabites.

H0387H.name: Ethan
H0387H.brief: Son of Zerah; grandson of Judah.
H0387H.short: Ethan was a son of Zerah and a grandson of Judah.

H0387G.name: Ethan
H0387G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0387G.brief: Wise man; Ezrahite; author of Psalm 89.
H0387G.short: Ethan the Ezrahite was a wise man and the author of Psalm 89.

H0326.name: Haahashtari
H0326.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0326.brief: A descendant of Judah through Hezron.
H0326.short: Haahashtari was a descendant of Judah through Hezron, as listed in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

H0350.name: Ichabod
H0350.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H0350.brief: Son of Phinehas, born when the ark was captured.
H0350.short: Ichabod was the son of Phinehas, born when the ark of God was captured by the Philistines and named to reflect the departure of glory from Israel.

H0378.name: Ish-bosheth
H0378.desc: Saul's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H0378.brief: Son of Saul, king over Israel.
H0378.short: Ish-bosheth (also called Eshbaal), Saul's son, was made king over Israel by Abner but was ultimately assassinated, leading to David's rule over all Israel.

H0379.name: Ishhod
H0379.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0379.short: Ishhod was the son of Hammoleketh, who was the sister of Manasseh.

H0385.name: Ithamar
H0385.desc: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0385.brief: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.
H0385.short: Ithamar was the fourth and youngest son of Aaron, who served as a priest alongside his brothers Nadab, Abihu, and Eleazar.

H0384G.name: Ithiel
H0384G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0384G.brief: Descendant of Benjamin living in Jerusalem.
H0384G.short: Ithiel, a descendant of Benjamin, was among those who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H0384H.name: Ithiel
H0384H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0384H.brief: Mentioned in Agur's sayings; meaning uncertain.
H0384H.short: Ithiel is mentioned twice in <ref="Proverbs 30:1">Proverbs 30:1</ref>, but the meaning and context of the name are uncertain.

H0348.name: Jezebel
H0348.desc: Queen living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0348.brief: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab
H0348.short: Queen Jezebel, the Phoenician wife of King Ahab, promoted Baal worship and persecuted the prophets of God.
H0348.meaning: “Baal exalts” or “Baal is husband to” or “unchaste”

forms.meaning: “Baal exalts” or “Baal is husband to” or “unchaste”

H0347.name: Job
H0347.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0347.brief: A righteous man who endured great suffering
H0347.short: Job, a blameless and upright man from Uz, endured severe trials and maintained his faith in God.

H0390.name: Accad
H0390.brief: An ancient city in Nimrod's kingdom, probably Akkad.
H0390.short: Accad, one of the cities in Nimrod's kingdom, likely the Akkadian city of Akkad.

H0392G.name: Achzib
H0392G.brief: A town in Judah, birthplace of Shelah.
H0392G.short: Achzib (Chezib, Cozeba), a town in Judah's Shephelah region.

H0392H.name: Achzib
H0392H.brief: A coastal town allotted to Asher.
H0392H.short: Achzib, a coastal city assigned to Asher but not conquered.

H0303.name: Ahlab
H0303.brief: A Canaanite city allotted to Asher.
H0303.short: Ahlab (Mahalab), a city in Asher's territory, not conquered by the Israelites.

H0357.name: Aijalon
H0357.brief: A Levitical city in Dan, site of Joshua's miracle.
H0357.short: Aijalon, a city allotted to Dan and the Levites, known for Joshua's miracle.

H0329G.name: Atad
H0329G.brief: Threshing floor where Egyptians mourned Jacob
H0329G.short: Atad was a threshing floor near the Jordan River where the Egyptians mourned Jacob's death.

H0307.name: Ecbatana
H0307.brief: A city in Media where a significant scroll was found.
H0307.short: Ecbatana was a city in Media where a scroll was found containing a decree by King Cyrus (<ref="Ezra 6:2">Ezra 6:2</ref>).

H0359A.name: Elath
H0359A.brief: Edomite port on the Red Sea; fortified by Judah
H0359A.short: Elath, an Edomite port on the Red Sea, was fortified by Judah during the reigns of Solomon and Uzziah.

H0362.name: Elim
H0362.brief: Desert oasis on Israel's journey from Egypt to Sinai
H0362.short: Elim, a desert oasis where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Mount Sinai.

H0356I.name: Elon
H0356I.brief: City in the territory of Dan
H0356I.short: Elon, a city allotted to the tribe of Dan during the division of the Promised Land.

H0358.name: Elonbeth-hanan
H0358.brief: City under the jurisdiction of Solomon's governor Ben-Deker
H0358.short: Elonbeth-hanan, a city under the jurisdiction of Ben-Deker, one of Solomon's twelve governors.

H0364.name: El-paran
H0364.brief: Wilderness area where the Horites were defeated by Chedorlaomer
H0364.short: El-paran, a wilderness region where Chedorlaomer and his allies defeated the Horites during their campaign.

H0388.name: Ethanim
H0388.brief: The seventh month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
H0388.short: Ethanim, mentioned in <ref="1Ki.8.2">1Ki.8.2</ref>, is the seventh month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to September-October in the modern calendar.
